blocks.text: Former Beatles member Paul McCartney has officially joined Forbes’ billionaire ranks, with an estimated net worth of $1.4 billion, making him the world’s third-richest musician. According to Forbes’ report published on Monday, Nov. 9, the British singer-songwriter ranks behind rapper Jay-Z, whose fortune is estimated at $2.8 billion, and singer Taylor Swift, with $2 billion. Much of McCartney’s wealth comes from his music publishing business, MPL Communications, which he established in 1969, months before The Beatles disbanded.
